propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with a rehearsal fixture containing nonexistent project keys (LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira Cloud.

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out queries every key in projects.json; when it attempts to build a JQL query for the nonexistent LEG project, Jira rejects it with a parse error (value 'leg' does not exist for field 'project'), causing ACLI to exit 1 and the entire reconcile pass to fail.

The corruption was introduced via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) authored with the test-fixture identity on the live tickets branch, 21 minutes before the first consistent Reconcile Bridge failure on 2026-08-15T02:39Z.

The canonical intended state for .bridge_state/projects.json is {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} (empty projects map causes the fan-out to fall back to the single configured project REB).
The bridge-state write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project) lacks a unified store write lock, auto-commit, and auto-publish, allowing ad-hoc hand-commits to corrupt the live branch.
